mutant.description: Four planted violations in a scratch copy of the root (.scratch/mutant, not committed, the committed files untouched). S_M1: a typed master number in place of ${each.key} in the command. S_M2: the events policy Resource list carries a star in place of the instance ARN. S_M3: masters.tf in the copy carries a cron that puts an Alongside fire on 22:15, a 49F fire time. S_M4: the variable default is ENABLED. Each is run against its named test with the test's root pointed at the copy.
mutant.expected: each planted violation fails its named test
mutant.observed: S_M1 -> test_ssm_command_fail_loud_and_no_49f_resource raised AssertionError (the command block lacks the -Master ${each.key} line). S_M2 -> test_role_scope_one_document_one_instance_no_star raised AssertionError (the Resource list is the document and a star). S_M3 -> test_fire_times_alongside_stagger_and_against_49f raised AssertionError at its first assertion (the masters map no longer equals the four-master literal); the stagger arm was not the one that fired. S_M4 -> test_disabled_default_validation_and_rule_state raised AssertionError.
